headline_marked: MLS: [[Messi can skip All-Star Game]] after grueling World Cup
headline: MLS: Messi can skip All-Star Game after grueling World Cup
summary: The league confirmed that the Inter Miami superstar will be excused from the annual showcase to allow for necessary rest after the international tournament.
details: Lionel Messi will not be required to play in next week's Major League Soccer All-Star Game. The decision comes after he represented Argentina in the recent World Cup final.

Participation in the annual showcase is usually mandatory for selected players, with exceptions typically only made for injuries. However, the league confirmed that pre-arranged exceptions were made for players who reached the final stages of the World Cup.
Major League Soccer and the MLS Players Association agreed that clubs would determine the appropriate rest and return timeline for players exiting the World Cup competition.

Alongside Messi, fellow Argentine Rodrigo De Paul will also be excused from the game. Both players featured in the last Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey, which Argentina lost 1-0 to Spain after extra time.
Messi had been among the first 11 players named to the MLS squad for the game, which takes place in Charlotte, North Carolina, on Wednesday.
The absence of Messi will be seen as a significant loss for the showcase, as he had been sanctioned last year for skipping the All-Star Game at the last minute.
In his absence, other stars like Son Heung-min, Thomas Muller, and US national team captain Tim Ream will feature in the match.

headline: Tk 28 lakh crore laundered: Govt wants to stop money laundering to boost investment
summary: Planning Minister Zunaid Saki says stopping capital flight will create investment pressure and build a job-based economy.
details: Planning Minister Zunaid Saki stated that the government aims to build an investment-driven, employment-based economy. To achieve this, stopping money laundering is essential, as a white paper committee report found that Tk 28 lakh crore was laundered from Bangladesh over the last 16 years.
caption:
Tk 28 lakh crore laundered in 16 years. The government now aims to stop this capital flight to force investment back into the country.
